branches.conclusion: College lists four business/economics schools. RSM PhD explicitly lists supported disciplines without Operations; RSFAS Statistics doctorate and named fields lack OR; Accounting/Economics titles likewise nonmatching. Current Ops faculty/topic evidence is not a formal doctorate area.

ANU School of Engineering generic PhD, Mathematical Sciences PhD named research areas and School of Computing doctoral clusters were inventoried; none is formally named Operations Research, Management Science or Industrial Engineering.

sources.note: Current Research School of Management PhD programme page gives school-wide management/business doctorate and lists supervision disciplines without named Operations or Management Science formal concentration.
University postgraduate research page identifies The Australian National University and current Doctor of Philosophy research degrees; no exact Ops title.

Current college RSM doctoral programme specification lists potential research disciplines and supervisor-matched entry; no named Operations doctoral field, even though some faculty research/individual students are Ops-related.
Current finance, actuarial studies and statistics school doctorate offerings list exact PhD disciplines; no Ops/Management Science title.
Current Statistics research field inventory contains statistics/probability/data-science fields, no named OR doctoral research area.
Mathematical Sciences Institute PhD/MPhil page enumerates its doctoral research areas; none is Operations Research.
School of Engineering current PhD programme is broad and supervisor-matched, with no named IE/Ops degree area.
School of Computing current HDR structure lists Computational Science, Computing Foundations, Intelligent Systems and Data Science clusters; no Operations Research named doctoral cluster.

limitations: Current plausible business/technical doctoral named-title and area inventory is source-bounded complete; no qualifying route.
Faculty Operations research and individual dissertation topics alone do not establish a formal named doctoral area.
One historical imported PhD institution report remains person-level discovery.
